name: Polished Demon Horn
text:
This spellheart is fashioned from the tip of a demon's horn that's been polished until smooth and shiny. The spell DC of any spell cast by Activating this item is 17.
- Armor You gain resistance 2 to unholy.
- Weapon After you cast an enchantment spell by Activating the horn, your Strikes with the weapon deal an additional 1d4 mental damage until end of your next turn.
Effect: Polished Demon Horn - Armor

Effect: Polished Demon Horn - Weapon

Activate Cast a Spell

Effect You cast Daze (DC 17 basic Will save).
